business_summary: IRRC Corporation engages in the life insurance agency business in Japan. The company operates Hoken Clinic, an insurance shop; Hoken IQ System, an insurance analysis and search system; development of insurance IQ systems and AS systems; and planning, development, sale, and operation of AI-OCR based ADX. It also provides insurtech solutions, such as know-how, AI-OCR, and Hoken Clinic franchise solutions. In addition, the company is involved in the life insurance consulting business; non-life insurance agency business; franchise store development business and related businesses; development and sales of computer software; business related to the solicitation of life insurance; and solutions business related to insurance sales support. IRRC Corporation was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Bunkyo, Japan.
